Hi on-call,

Three batch jobs failed on 2026-10-17 (UTC). feature-backfill-daily also failed once (S3 SlowDown) but its rerun r-88305 succeeded, so it is not listed.

data-platform
1. pg-nightly-backup, run r-88213, 02:00-02:47
   Error: pg_dump: error: could not write to output file: No space left on device
   /backups (2.0T) was 100% full. A 1.21 TiB partial dump is still on disk and backup-retention last pruned on 10-14.
   Next step: find out why backup-retention has not run since 10-14, delete the partial file, then re-run the backup today.

billing
2. invoice-sync, run r-88240, 04:15, failed after 3 attempts
   Error: HTTPError: 401 Client Error: Unauthorized for url: https://billing-api.acme.example/v3/invoices?updated_since=2026-10-16T04:15:00Z
   Next step: the service token was probably rotated or expired; check the invoice-sync credentials.

search
3. search-reindex, run r-88257, 05:30-06:12
   Error: Container search-reindex-7d9f exceeded memory limit (8Gi) and was OOMKilled
   Next step: raise the limit or lower the batch size, and check whether the index grew this week.

-- oncall-digest (automated run, 2026-10-18 09:14 UTC)
